item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We are clear: commercial deep-sea mining will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. Once these ancient habitats are crushed and buried, they cannot be restored. We must stop this industry before it starts.

2. We refuse to turn the deep ocean into an industrial sacrifice zone. Commercial mining will erase habitats, destroy marine life and cause permanent ecological damage—all for private profit.

3. The deep ocean is alive, irreplaceable and not for sale. We stand against commercial deep-sea mining because it will permanently destroy ecosystems that no technology, regulation or restoration plan can bring back.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 109 words

Deep-sea mining will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. If companies send industrial machines into these ancient habitats, they will crush seabeds, erase species and spread sediment through waters that have never faced disruption on this scale. We refuse to treat the deep ocean as a sacrifice zone for short-term profit. Its living systems cannot be rebuilt once they are torn apart, and no regulation can make irreversible destruction responsible. That is why we are calling for commercial deep-sea mining to be stopped before it starts. Together, we can defend the largest habitat on Earth, protect the life it sustains and keep permanent damage from becoming the legacy of our time.
